test_load_partial_checkpoint: test loading a partial checkpoint and verify epoch iterator resumes at the correct iteration
test_load_full_checkpoint: test loading a full checkpoint and verify the epoch iterator advances to the next epoch
test_load_no_checkpoint: test starting training from scratch when no checkpoint file exists on disk
test_finetune_from_model: test finetuning from a pretrained model and verify optimizer and scheduler are reset
test_finetune_from_model_resume: test resuming a finetuning run and verify optimizer state is preserved instead of reset
